findings.reason: Revised proof step 3.1 to limit multiplication to convergent products of Green coproduct images and finite sums, removing the unsupported global completion and topological bialgebra claim. This matches Schiffmann §1.5, which says the completion is not an algebra and the image products converge ([source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0611617v2#page=12)). Statement and definition unchanged.

Moved Schur descent before the Frobenius orbit count and proved that each small-degree fixed-class set is finite by counting arrow-matrix tuples over the finite field. This justifies enlarging the orbit-count constant. Statement unchanged.

For finite quiver representations over a finite field the basis coproducts have finite support; its compatibility use requires no algebra structure on the whole completion.
Its indirect use through the Ringel-map proposition is unchanged.
It uses the unchanged Schur-descent statement; the revised proof supplies the finite small-degree bound used in the orbit count.
